case_title.quote: SARDAR ALI KHAN v. THE STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH THROUGH PRINCIPAL SECRETARY HOME DEPARTMENT & ANR.

accused_gender.quote: the appellant... who is stated to be about 87 years

accused_age.quote: the appellant who is stated to be about 87 years

victim_gender.reason: Complainant/victim 2nd respondent is male and the deceased father is male.
